verdict.rationale: Workers is documented as a serverless platform with 'no servers to manage' and no region complexity, and the Agents SDK that runs on it claims automatic scaling 'to tens of millions of instances'. That implies automatic scaling, but nothing explicitly documents load-based autoscaling or how Workers absorbs large traffic bursts. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of load-based autoscaling for Workers itself, burst-handling behavior and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration under traffic spikes

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can rely on load-based autoscaling to absorb large traffic bursts automatically

citations.quote: No servers to manage. No cold starts or region complexity.
Deploy once and Cloudflare runs your agents across its global network, scaling to tens of millions of instances.
